author: El-Shai - Spilling Egypt’s Latest Tea
text:
Every September, we convince ourselves that a new notebook, fresh pens, and a suspicious number of pastel highlighters will finally make us productive. Psychologists call it the “fresh start effect”: the feeling that a new semester gives us a chance to become a better version of ourselves.

But in Egypt, that clean slate comes with a price tag. Between tuition, private lessons, books, and transport, families are already spending heavily before the stationery shopping even begins. Social media only adds pressure to buy aesthetic supplies we barely use.

Before joining the haul, check what you already have. Your old pens might still work.
